time_conventions.solar_geometry_time_basis: nominal UTC from the AGRI filename; obs_time_offset_s retains the actual per-scan-line timing for optional later recomputation

aux_fields.cosSOZ: cos(SOZ), computed at nominal filename UTC
aux_fields.cosRAA: cos(SOA-SAA), computed at nominal filename UTC
aux_fields.agri_valid_bits: uint16 bit0-bit14 for C01-C15; 1 means raw DN and calibrated value passed fill, mask, valid-range and LUT checks before night zeroing
aux_fields.agri_valid_mask: uint8 source-calibration validity before visible-channel night zeroing; 1 where all 13 AGRI channels used by the current SimVP input (C01-C06,C09-C15) are valid
aux_fields.obs_time_offset_s: actual NOMObsTime scan-line midpoint minus nominal filename UTC, seconds; NaN where source scan time is unavailable
aux_fields.agri_valid_fraction: cached mean of agri_valid_mask for indexing
aux_fields.all_channel_valid_fraction: cached fraction with all C01-C15 valid
aux_fields.source_type: historical or realtime source selected for this frame
aux_fields.source_hdf: absolute source HDF path used for this frame
aux_fields.source_size_bytes: source file size verified stable during the read
aux_fields.source_mtime_ns: source file mtime_ns verified stable during the read
aux_fields.data_quality: raw root Data Quality attribute; -1 if unavailable
aux_fields.incomplete_scans: raw root Incomplete Scans attribute; -1 if unavailable
aux_fields.qa_scan_flag: raw root QA_Scan_Flag attribute; -1 if unavailable
aux_fields.qa_pixel_flag: raw root QA_Pixel_Flag attribute; -1 if unavailable
aux_fields.sun_avoidance_flag: raw root Sun Avoidance Flag attribute; -1 if unavailable
